input: 20 mins. Year 6 history. Teach why two people can read the same source and disagree.
intendedConcept: why two people can disagree about the same source
issues: The opening states the explanation before the class has investigated.
requiredKnowledge: Different people can have different perspectives.
Bias can influence how a source is interpreted.
Context of a source can change its meaning.
Interpretation of sources can vary based on individual experiences.
People interpret sources differently because they have unique backgrounds and experiences.

teacherIntent.learningGoal: Understand why two people can read the same source and disagree.
teacherIntent.subject: History

applyAlignment.semanticReason: The instruction requires using knowledge of perspectives and bias to interpret a historical source.

modelApply.instruction: In pairs, analyze a historical source and discuss your interpretations.
modelApply.target: Share how your backgrounds might influence your views.
modelApply.knowledgeUsed: Different people can have different perspectives.
modelApply.successCondition: You can explain your interpretation and its influences.
modelApply.teachingConnection: This activity uses the concepts we just learned.

finalApply.instruction: In pairs, examine a historical source and share your different interpretations.
finalApply.target: Discuss how your backgrounds might influence your views.
finalApply.knowledgeUsed: Different people can have different perspectives.
finalApply.successCondition: You can explain how your interpretations differ.
finalApply.teachingConnection: This task connects to understanding how context and bias affect views.
